title: Please add a note to the following two xDrip releases
symptom: Users install the November 15 and November 26, 2020 releases and report connectivity issues with Dexcom transmitters.
fix: Add a note to the release descriptions warning about connectivity issues for Dexcom transmitters, or remove the releases from public access.
evidence_quote: I've added "Connectivity issues for Dexcom transmitters have been reported. Do not install this build if you are using Dexcom hardware source" to the description.
